name: Elan Imperial
summary: Existence, developer, Sector 82 location, RERA RC/REP/HARERA/GGM/788/520/2024/15, under-construction status, land area (7.6-7.65 acres) and 1,305 units are confirmed. Sources disagree on the starting price: ₹1.3 Cr (marketing partner) is close to our ₹1.43 Cr, while Square Yards says ₹1.89 Cr. Only the first-floor rate (₹29,750/sq ft) in our floor-wise price list could be confirmed. We publish no possession date, while portals give 2027 or December 2028.

checks.web: Elan Imperial, luxury retail/hospitality mall project in Sector 82, Gurgaon

checks.note: We could not confirm the legal promoter entity 'Elan Limited'.
